summary: A Harrow dental practice appears to lose new patients to Covid news from 2020 and a 2017 copyright date.

findings.problem: The Latest News section appears to show Covid-19 posts dated 14 November 2020.
findings.cost: Old Covid news tells a patient the practice may not be active, so they book another practice.
findings.fix: Fresh news or a clean page with no old posts.

findings.problem: The footer appears to say Copyright 2017 Bright Dental Practice.
findings.cost: An old date makes the site look abandoned.

findings.problem: No WhatsApp or text option appears, only a phone number and a contact form.
findings.cost: Patients who want a quick answer message first.
findings.fix: A one tap text button and online booking.
